business_question: You are supporting a New York Times editor who is fact-checking a reporter's proposed statement that the Titanic evacuation followed a 'women and children first' practice. Using the supplied Titanic passenger dataset, determine what the data show about the relationship between sex and survival. Give a numerical answer using survivor counts, survival rates, the percentage-point difference, and the relative survival rate. Create one chart illustrating the result for the editor. Distinguish an observed association from proof that a particular evacuation policy or order caused the result, and identify briefly what this dataset alone cannot establish.
business_answer_shown: Women and children first was proven.

improved_chart.chart_type: Horizontal bar chart comparing survival rates by recorded sex
improved_chart.title: Female survival rate was 53.6 percentage points higher
improved_chart.accessibility_notes: 1600x1080 PNG; high-contrast large text, direct rates and counts, a common 0-100% scale, no color-only encoding, and an on-chart note identifying the untested children/age claim component.

remaining_limitations: The chart tests only recorded sex versus survival. It does not test the children/age component of the proposed statement; 263 of the 1,309 age entries are NA.
The supplied records cannot establish whether an evacuation policy or order existed, was applied, or caused the observed difference.
The completeness and coding accuracy of the underlying historical passenger dataset were not independently audited.
Passenger class, timing, and other potential factors were not analyzed; this specialist did not perform a new baseline or child-survival analysis.
The baseline's exact bar heights cannot be recovered from its raster image; only approximate visual agreement with verified rates can be assessed.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: No additional information is needed for the observed sex-survival comparison. Evaluating the untested children/age component would require a separately authorized analysis with an explicit age definition and a plan for the 263 NA entries.
A claim about an evacuation policy, order, or causal mechanism would require independent historical evidence beyond this passenger spreadsheet.
